name: Thai Tofu Vegetable Soup
ingredients: ½ cup sliced carrot or baby corn
1 stalk lemongrass, bruised and cut in 3
1 tsp vegan Thai red curry paste (check the label)
steps: Heat the oil and fry the curry paste for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the stock, lemongrass and ginger and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add carrot, mushrooms and tofu and simmer for 6 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and soy sauce and heat gently for 2 minutes.
Remove the lemongrass, then finish with lime juice and fresh herbs.
note: Many commercial curry pastes contain shrimp paste; use one labelled vegan.
